verdict.rationale: Paxos's own Payments guide documents accepting PYUSD, USDC and USDP on-chain, with an option to automatically convert receipts to fiat (rather than holding stablecoin) and settle USD directly to a bank account. The redeem orchestration and the Fiat Transfers API (Fedwire, SWIFT, CUBIX) back up the bank-payout leg. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-conversion settlement flow, and deeper documentation of how auto-conversion is configured (triggers, timing, fees) in the payments product.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto

citations.quote: Accept PYUSD, USDC and USDP payments via on-chain transfers.
Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin.
Settle USD directly to your bank account.
Convert stablecoins to USD and withdraw to your bank in one call.
The Fiat Transfers API allows clients to deposit and withdraw fiat via Wire (Fedwire and SWIFT) and CUBIX networks.
